description: This file defines the class 'ThingPreconditionNotModifiedException', a custom exception class used within the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate a specific HTTP 304 Not Modified error related to precondition headers on a 'Thing' resource. It includes methods for creating instances, parsing from JSON, and building with a builder pattern.

classes.name: ThingPreconditionNotModifiedException
classes.description: A custom runtime exception class representing a 304 Not Modified error related to precondition headers on a Thing resource.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing 'ThingPreconditionNotModifiedException' objects with specific expected and actual match values.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Constructs an instance of 'ThingPreconditionNotModifiedException' from a JSON object containing error details.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
